decisions.reason: Transactional email is core to the firm's messaging offering and shown on the home page, indicating it meets aspirations, so the firm keeps it with very low drop probability.
Document capture aligns with digital business processes and has its own page, suggesting satisfactory results relative to aspirations, so it is kept with low probability.
Email-to-fax conversion supports hybrid and compliance use cases, and with slack and no reported shortfall, the firm keeps it despite modest website visibility.
Fax delivery optimization is close to the established offer and fax remains relevant in regulated German processes, so it is kept, though lower prominence raises its drop probability slightly.
Email sandbox threat protection addresses security needs but is less prominent; given slack and no clear negative signal, it is kept with a moderate low probability.
Multi-engine virus scanning is a complementary security feature and, with no evidence of falling short of aspirations and available slack, the firm keeps it with low probability.
